latest_clusters.topic_label: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva Defeats Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazilian Presidential Runoff Election
latest_clusters.synthesis: Incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva defeated Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in Brazil's presidential runoff election, securing a historic fourth presidential term. After losing the first round on October 4 where Bolsonaro took 47% to Lula's 45%, Lula secured 51.0% to 51.75% of the popular vote in the second round, compared to Bolsonaro's 48.25% to 48.68% (a difference of over 2.6 million votes), as confirmed by Brazil's Superior Electoral Court.
